phases.story_function: Make the audience watch an information problem become a material recording problem before claiming that writing suddenly appears.
phases.state_change: From multiple accounting/authentication devices to numerical information carried directly and durably on clay surfaces.
phases.gap: The Chogha Mish objects are illustrative parallels, not a proven direct genealogy into Uruk proto-cuneiform.

phases.story_function: Show why the earliest writing can be consequential even when it does not encode continuous speech.
phases.state_change: From expecting readable sentences to recognizing that quantity, commodity and layout can preserve operational relations.
phases.gap: Do not identify the underlying Uruk IV–III language or invent a complete transaction where verbs/context are absent.

phases.story_function: Turn writing from a narrow administrative tool into an expanding repertoire without narrating a simple accounting-to-literature ladder.
phases.state_change: From durable classification to letters, schooling and retrospective political/literary memory as added and recombined uses.
phases.gap: The four cases are deliberately bounded and cannot stand for every city, period or genre.

phases.story_function: Reveal that marks become infrastructure only when competence can be reproduced in people.
phases.state_change: From a tablet as an object to a training process of model, copy, erasure, memorization and revision.
phases.gap: House F is Old Babylonian and cannot be projected backward as the school system of Uruk.

phases.story_function: Test the feedback claim: records enlarge institutional capacity only when embedded in authentication, retrieval and authority.
phases.state_change: From documents that preserve claims to record systems that let institutions aggregate and retrieve obligations—while a failed order proves the tablet does not enforce itself.
phases.gap: Puzriš-Dagan is a later Ur III test case, not direct evidence for the magnitude of the feedback loop at Uruk.

phases.story_function: Explain survival as costly adaptation by trained communities rather than purity of script or language.
phases.state_change: From a Mesopotamian scribal system to selectively adapted practices capable of encoding new linguistic environments.
phases.gap: WS07 has a defensible process carrier but not yet an object-level adoption scene with a tight locator.

phases.story_function: Separate survival of clay from survival of competent practice so decline can be narrated as institutional contraction rather than one last dramatic collapse.
phases.state_change: From a living reproduced tradition to surviving tablets without continuous reading competence.
phases.gap: The 75 CE latest-known tablet remains a qualified chronological anchor, but current handoff lacks a sufficiently narrow object identifier for scene-level use.

phases.story_function: Close the lifecycle by making modern knowledge itself the consequence of a second, post-break process.
phases.state_change: From mute surviving signs to cumulatively recoverable languages through copying, multilingual comparison and repeated testing.
phases.gap: Do not compress decipherment into one hero or eureka moment.

opening_candidates.reason: VAT 14682 makes the central paradox immediately visible: a document can preserve a useful relation even when it is not a readable sentence.
P005390 is a stronger museum-ready alternative with bounded grain-related structure and explicit interpretive limits.

reversal_candidates.reason: A written royal order fails to become action, forcing the story to separate documentary power from enforcement.
The teacher–student tablet reveals that the durable technology is not clay alone but reproduced human competence.
The archive shows the return arrow: once records are embedded in procedure, institutions can operate at a different scale.

ending_candidates.reason: Decipherment turns the apparent endpoint into a second transformation: material survival without competence, then competence reconstructed from evidence.

gaps: No defensible single invention scene should be manufactured from WS01.
The long technical transformation from proto-cuneiform to mature wedge ductus lacks a tight comparative object sequence in the current handoff.
A scene-level Hittite adoption sequence needs tighter object locators if the outline wants more than a process carrier.
The 75 CE latest-known endpoint needs object-level metadata before it can carry a scene rather than a qualified claim.
The Uruk-to-Ur III chronological jump must remain explicit: later archives test a feedback mechanism; they do not prove its early magnitude.
